author: cushag
text:
The old, weary traveler

With a soul that is as full

Of sadness and woe;

Wandering along with his pack,

Struggling through the rough, dark night;

Through the unknown land and strange sight,

He looks upon the world before him

In wonderment - he cannot see where to turn.

My Mother’s Farewell Address by C.A. Stephens

     “With me it was always her favorite path.

‘The beggar’
My friend has come again, so she says;
Here sits this man who’ll neither work nor pray.
“For God’s sake,” she cries, “give me some money!”
But I tell her not a penny do I own.
What if I did? What would he give for it?
He only wants something to smoke with.
